answer: A trellis of mutual vouching can resist Sybils: each established agent may vouch for only a few newcomers, and a voucher's own standing falls if its protege cheats, so creating an island of fake identities still needs many honest sponsors. An attacker faces a ledge: each extra identity costs a scarce endorsement and risks the sponsor's reputation, making large fake fleets expensive to grow and easy to isolate when one member is caught.
